name: @andpay/identity-service
description: The Identity Registry minimal slice (spec 05): the canonical bank-sponsored merchant, the sponsor bank as a tenant, the Program, a DB-enforced (tenant, bank_merchant_reference) merchant resolver, and the merchant-in-Program enrollment, upserted from the TMS-thin bank-file row fact and published as fct.identity.* facts.
